marketing_data_policy.content: Marketing Data Handling Policy v3.1: All event registration imports must reconcile against existing CRM contacts before any new contact creation to prevent duplicates. Opt-out preferences captured at registration are binding and override list additions. New subscribers may only be added to mailing lists after a human reviewer signs off on the reconciled batch. Source field values must be preserved verbatim in all downstream records and communications.
